name: Temple Grandin
bio: Temple Grandin is an autistic scientist and a professor at Colorado State University.
challenge: Grandin has described sensory sensitivities and the challenges she faced navigating a world not built for autistic people.
madePossible: She used her visual thinking to design livestock-handling systems and became a widely known voice on autism.
takeaway: There is more than one way to think, learn, and contribute.

name: Simone Biles
bio: Simone Biles is an American gymnast and an Olympic gold medalist in 2016 and 2024.
challenge: At the Tokyo Olympics in 2021, Biles experienced the “twisties,” a loss of spatial awareness, and withdrew from several events.
madePossible: She prioritized her health and safety, returned to competition, and won the all-around title again at Paris 2024.
takeaway: Protecting your well-being can be an act of strength.

name: Judith Heumann
bio: Judith Heumann was an American disability-rights leader whose work helped advance access and inclusion.
challenge: A wheelchair user after having polio, she faced exclusion from school and was initially denied a teaching license in New York City.
madePossible: She helped lead the 1977 Section 504 sit-in, part of the movement that secured federal disability-rights regulations.
takeaway: You deserve access and belonging, not an exception.
